On a clear day, you can see Caracas and the Caribbean Sea from here. At the summit, you can take a walk, shop for souvenirs and enjoy strawberries with cream and hot cocoa.

The excursion includes the historic Hotel Humboldt, built in Venezuela in 1956 and described as the world's first seven-star hotel. Inside, preserved museum rooms, restaurants, a club, a bar, original mosaics and interior features can be seen. The hotel also houses the Gaviota bar and a piano presented as a gift by John F. Kennedy.
